index.html.meta.title: FinDera Consulting — Your connection to sustainable solutions in Europe
index.html.meta.desc: International solution scans, contacts, expert meetings and study and benchmarking trips for organisations.
index.html.hero.title: Your connection tosustainable Europe.
index.html.hero.lead: FinDera helps projects and organisations find the right sustainable solutions, players and practical lessons in Europe – from scans and opening contacts to expert study trips. What you see, hear and experience for yourself, you understand more deeply.
index.html.intro.title: The right information, the right people and first-hand experience.
index.html.intro.lead: Not every need starts with a trip. Sometimes the right first step is an international solution scan, a well-founded shortlist or opening a contact with a specific organisation.
index.html.intro.p1: At other times the greatest value comes from seeing a solution in practice and discussing it directly with the people who built it.
index.html.intro.p2: FinDera designs the approach that fits your goal – from scans and contacts to meetings, expert study trips and follow-up work on the lessons learned.
index.html.svc.title: Four complementary ways to move forward.
index.html.svc.lead: I help organisations find the right solutions, players and partners in Europe – and turn them into usable knowledge, meetings and next steps. You can start from whichever stage fits your situation.
index.html.svc1.title: Scans and briefing packs
index.html.svc1.when: When you need a well-founded picture of international solutions, players or potential partners.
index.html.svc1.desc: A focused scan, a comparable shortlist and clear conclusions to support decision-making, project planning or preparing an expert study trip.
index.html.svc2.title: The right contacts and meetings
index.html.svc2.when: When you want to talk with the right experts, companies or networks.
index.html.svc2.desc: I identify suitable players, open the contacts and give each meeting a clear goal and a coherent discussion structure.
index.html.svc3.title: Site visits and expert study trips
index.html.svc3.when: When you want to see solutions in practice, exchange experiences and build a shared view within your group.
index.html.svc3.desc: I plan and run goal-oriented site visits and study and benchmarking trips across Europe.
index.html.onsite.title: Information structures the options – meeting in person deepens understanding.
index.html.onsite.lead: A good scan helps identify the relevant solutions, players and points of comparison. In personal meetings and on site visits, how well they work can be assessed in practice – and you gain access to experience and tacit knowledge that rarely appear in published sources.
index.html.onsite.1.title: Tacit knowledge passes on face to face
index.html.onsite.1.desc: What never makes it into a report — what cost more than planned, what did not work and what they would do differently — is told when you ask, on site.
index.html.onsite.2.title: The questions arise in the moment
index.html.onsite.2.desc: On site you sense the scale, the smell and the sound for yourself. The best questions are not on a list prepared in advance; they come from what you have just seen.
index.html.onsite.3.title: Over dinner the group gets to know one another
index.html.onsite.3.desc: After the day the conversation carries on informally. That is when participants really get to know each other — and that network is often the most lasting outcome of the trip.
index.html.why.title: Dependable quality in knowledge and contacts.
index.html.why.lead: Long experience means I recognise the solutions that work and can pick the sites that genuinely benefit you — while making sure the encounters are well run and worth the time. Progress stays controlled, purposeful and productive.
index.html.why.1.title: Precise scoping and targeting
index.html.why.1.desc: I define the criteria together with you and quickly identify the most relevant solutions, sites and players.
index.html.why.2.title: Relationships with the right people
index.html.why.2.desc: I turn contacts into concrete encounters and make sure each discussion has a clear objective and structure.
index.html.why.3.title: Comparable practical understanding
index.html.why.3.desc: I distil what works in practice and under what conditions — to support your decision-making.
index.html.why.4.title: Impact and next steps
index.html.why.4.desc: I take the work towards the next stage: a draft decision, a pilot, a partnership path or a clear roadmap.
index.html.why.5.title: A rare perspective
index.html.why.5.desc: My multi-stakeholder background brings realism, an overall picture and the ability to combine the needs of different parties.
index.html.why.6.title: Track record and networks
index.html.why.6.desc: More than 70 projects and around 1,300 participants. I work across Europe, and my strongest base of projects and networks is in Germany, the rest of the DACH region and the Netherlands. In Germany, my knowledge of the language, culture and market adds further value.
index.html.quote.1.text: FinDera delivered the trip for our management team and board very smoothly on a turnkey basis. The trip provided valuable shared time, new perspectives and strengthened our common view of developing the company.
index.html.quote.2.text: Martin planned the trip largely on a turnkey basis while still taking our wishes into account. During the trip he was an invaluable guide, tour leader and interpreter, which made the whole thing successful and effortless.
index.html.quote.3.text: FinDera built an excellent package at board level: relevant sites, well-prepared meetings and smooth arrangements. We gained a valuable knowledge base to support investment decisions.

palvelut.html.meta.title: Solution scans, contacts and expert study trips | FinDera
palvelut.html.meta.desc: FinDera helps you find the right sustainable solutions and players in Europe and builds scans, meetings and expert study trips.
palvelut.html.ph.title: The right solutions, the right sites, the right people.
palvelut.html.ph.lead: I help organisations identify sustainable solutions, players and partners in Europe that fit their goals – and turn the findings into usable knowledge, meetings and practical progress. The service can be a focused scan, opening contacts, a meeting programme, an expert study trip or a combination of these.
palvelut.html.aii.1.desc: I secure the meetings and site visits that are otherwise hard to reach — and create personal contacts and confidential conversations. I know how to meet people, and clients tell me I am approachable and easy to talk to.
palvelut.html.aii.2.desc: I identify contacts and sites according to your objectives, so that what you learn is comparable, relevant and applicable in practice. I also bring valuable cultural understanding.
palvelut.html.aii.3.desc: I take the whole towards a shared direction and next steps — decisions, pilots and collaboration.
palvelut.html.p1.title: Site visits and expert study trips
palvelut.html.p1.when: When you want to see solutions in practice, exchange experiences with those who implemented them and build a shared view within your group.
palvelut.html.p1.desc: I plan goal-oriented site visits and study and benchmarking trips across Europe for expert, management and stakeholder groups. The package can be delivered as a content programme or turnkey together with a travel agency partner. Where needed, I act as tour leader, facilitator and interpreter.
palvelut.html.p1.li1: Sites chosen around your objectives: the best practical examples and comparable implementations
palvelut.html.p1.li2: Confirmed meetings and an agenda that supports real exchange — not just a presentation
palvelut.html.p1.li3: Pacing, facilitation and, where needed, tour leadership and interpreting
palvelut.html.p1.li4: Coordination of travel logistics and restaurants
palvelut.html.p1.li5: A good and constructive atmosphere throughout
palvelut.html.p1.m1.title: Turnkey
palvelut.html.p1.m1.desc: A travel package through my travel agency partner: planning, sites, logistics and tour leadership from a single source.
palvelut.html.p1.m2.title: Programme only
palvelut.html.p1.m2.desc: A confirmed programme with everything you need to know — you handle the logistics yourself or with your own travel agency.
palvelut.html.price.q: What does a group trip cost?
palvelut.html.price.p1: The cost of a group trip can be covered through project or other funding, split into per-participant fees, or invoiced to the client in full.
palvelut.html.price.p2: The price always follows the content and the way the trip is delivered. It depends on the length of the trip and the destination area, the size of the group, the number of site visits, meals and other programme, and whether I travel with you as tour leader. On request, travel logistics — flights, accommodation and coach transfers — can be included as well; the full travel package is then provided by the travel agency partner I work with.
palvelut.html.price.figure: Ballpark €1,200–1,800 + VAT / participant On the three-day trips to Central Europe delivered so far, the total cost has typically been at this level, with travel logistics and my tour leadership included.
palvelut.html.price.p3: Every trip is nevertheless planned as its own package. The right way to deliver it, the content and an initial budget frame are gone through together already in the first conversation.
palvelut.html.p2.title: Opening doors and curated meetings
palvelut.html.p2.when: When you are looking for partners, benchmarks, experts or a conversation with interesting European organisations.
palvelut.html.p2.desc: I identify organisations and people that fit your goal, open the contacts and give confirmed meetings a clear goal and discussion structure. My particular strengths are Germany and the rest of the DACH region, where my knowledge of the language, culture and market supports building connections.
palvelut.html.p2.li1: Identifying the right organisations and people
palvelut.html.p2.li3: A programme of confirmed meetings and a discussion outline
palvelut.html.p2.li4: Background briefing, facilitation and interpreting when needed
palvelut.html.p3.title: International solution and partner scan
palvelut.html.p3.when: When you need a well-founded picture of which solutions are in use in Europe, who the most interesting players are, and which options are worth a closer look.
palvelut.html.p3.desc: A scan can be a compact search for sites or partners, or a broader international solution scan. The scope is always set by your decision-making situation and information needs.
palvelut.html.p3.li1: Defining the goal and selection criteria
palvelut.html.p3.li2: Identifying international solutions, implementations and players
palvelut.html.p3.li3: Pre-screening the options and a well-founded shortlist
palvelut.html.steps.title2: A light start and an approach that fits your goal
palvelut.html.p1.desc3: I design the whole so that it is strong in substance and smooth in practice — and so that it also creates valuable connections and shared next steps among the participants themselves.
palvelut.html.p1.who: Who it is for: projects and development organisations (kick-off, engagement), companies and management (benchmarking, groundwork for investment, board and leadership team programmes), and associations and training programmes.
palvelut.html.p2.c1: Finding partners and entering markets in Europe
palvelut.html.p2.c2: Comparing solutions and technologies as a basis for an investment decision
palvelut.html.p2.c3: A visit programme that supports board and leadership discussions
palvelut.html.p2.m1.title: Meeting programme only
palvelut.html.p2.m1.desc: A confirmed programme with everything you need to know — you handle the logistics yourself or with your own travel agency.
palvelut.html.p2.m2.title: Turnkey
palvelut.html.p2.m2.desc: A travel package through my travel agency partner, from planning through to logistics.
palvelut.html.p3.li5: A written summary and key conclusions
palvelut.html.pwhy.title: Encounters that land, lessons that last.
palvelut.html.pwhy.lead: At its best, what a trip yields keeps paying off long after everyone has gone home. Five things set the work apart.
palvelut.html.pwhy.1.title: A grasp of the subject
palvelut.html.pwhy.1.desc: I can connect the themes and find the one site that is genuinely worth visiting. Sustainability, energy, the circular economy and the environment are the core of my work.
palvelut.html.pwhy.2.title: Opening doors
palvelut.html.pwhy.2.desc: I secure meetings with the right people and with the right agenda.
palvelut.html.pwhy.3.title: Reliable delivery
palvelut.html.pwhy.3.desc: A rhythm that works, realistic logistics, smooth running and good group dynamics.
palvelut.html.pwhy.4.title: A multi-stakeholder view
palvelut.html.pwhy.4.desc: It comes from a career spanning the private sector, the public sector and central government.
palvelut.html.pwhy.5.title: Tour leadership and a good atmosphere
palvelut.html.pwhy.5.desc: Smooth execution, good spirit, and a trip participants remember.
palvelut.html.pwhy.note: The hardest work and the real risk are not in the itinerary on paper. They are in the quality of the sites, in getting the meetings confirmed, in a rhythm that holds, and in whether the visits genuinely serve the objective. Get those right and the trip produces insights, contacts and concrete next steps.
palvelut.html.alt.palvelu-tapaamiset-2: Visitors in hard hats looking out over the container port of Rotterdam from a high viewing platform.
palvelut.html.alt.palvelu-kartoitus-2: Experts examining process displays and diagrams at a plant.
palvelut.html.ph.scope: I work across Europe. My strongest base of projects, experience and networks is in Germany, the rest of the DACH region and the Netherlands. The overarching theme is sustainability in the broad sense: for example energy and environmental solutions, the circular and bioeconomy, biodiversity, social sustainability, and sustainable food and tourism.
palvelut.html.p3.li6: A recommendation on next steps or possible benchmarking visits
palvelut.html.p3.casesdesc: A scan suits, for example, preparing an investment or procurement, project planning, strategy work, partner searches and preparing an expert study trip.
palvelut.html.p2.li5: A summary of key findings, contacts and next steps
palvelut.html.brief.title: Benchmark Brief – background and insights in one place
palvelut.html.brief.p1: An expert study trip can include a concise Benchmark Brief. It brings together the trip's theme, the most interesting solutions and players, background on the sites visited and the key questions for comparison in an easy-to-use format.
palvelut.html.brief.p2: The brief helps participants prepare for the meetings and, after the trip, supports shared discussion, decision-making and follow-up.
palvelut.html.p4.title: Summarising and working on the lessons
palvelut.html.p4.lead: A scan, meetings or an expert study trip can be the start of longer-term development. Where needed, I help the group gather the key findings, identify shared conclusions and define concrete next steps.
palvelut.html.p4.desc: This can take the form of a facilitated summary discussion, small-group work or a compact workshop as part of a scan or trip.

Participants: the trip was organised by Southwest Finland Waste Management (LSJH) as part of the Ohituskaista uudelleenkäyttöön reuse project. Sites: subsurface drainage machinery plants, research institutes, and construction and design sites.
projektit.html.case.ely.more:
Participants: project leads and members together with invited organisations, among them MTK, the Baltic Sea Action Group, AFRY, Vaisala and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. Sixteen people in all.

Content: practical solutions and models of cooperation in urban, agricultural and water management adaptation. The trip was delivered within the IBA and Lossi projects.
projektit.html.case.osao.more:
Participants: project leads and members together with invited organisations, among them Lassila & Tikanoja, VTT, Micropolis, Lapland UAS and OAMK. Twenty people in all.

Content: sorting and recycling on construction sites, construction waste treatment technologies, a building materials recycling plant, waste heat recovery and use, an ”eco-block” with its own power and heat generation and smart control, ESCO projects, and energy management and storage.

Background: the trip was planned jointly with the ERDF-funded Energiaratkaisut 2020 and Teolliset symbioosit Pohjois-Pohjanmaalla projects and Micropolis in Ii.

minusta.html.meta.title: Martin Brandt — FinDera Consulting
minusta.html.meta.desc: Martin Brandt is a sustainability and circular economy consultant who has been building connections between Finnish and European organisations since 2006.
minusta.html.ph.title: Martin Brandt — FinDera
minusta.html.ph.lead: I combine experience, networks and hands-on delivery so that your project or business can grow sustainably and successfully.
minusta.html.about.title: At the pulse of sustainable solutions.
minusta.html.about.lead: Since 2006 I have helped create hundreds of connections related to sustainability and foreign trade — in business management, project management and consulting roles.
minusta.html.about.p1: Working in the public and private sectors as well as in central government sustainability has given me a deep understanding of what different actors need in my home countries and internationally — particularly in energy, the circular economy and environmental technology solutions more broadly.
minusta.html.about.p2: I have created hundreds of new connections between organisations and, through them, an extensive personal network in Finland, Germany and across Europe. I have also lectured at Aalto University and Åbo Akademi, among others.
minusta.html.about.p3: Broad experience means I can recognise workable solutions and choose the sites that genuinely benefit you — ensuring that every encounter is high in quality, smooth and worthwhile.
minusta.html.career.title: Perspectives from every side.
minusta.html.career.lead: My multi-stakeholder background brings realism, an overall picture and the ability to combine the needs of different parties — I have been, in turn, the client, the deliverer and the broker.
minusta.html.career.1.title: German-Finnish Chamber of Commerce
minusta.html.career.1.desc: As project director I delivered projects and trips for the German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs relating to energy, the circular economy and export cooperation.
minusta.html.career.2.title: Valonia
minusta.html.career.2.desc: Project director at the Southwest Finland service centre for sustainable development and energy, working at the interface between municipal and business collaboration.
minusta.html.career.3.title: Sweco Finland Oy
minusta.html.career.3.desc: Circular economy development and project manager on the infrastructure side, working directly with clients. Among other things I drew up master plans for circular economy areas.
minusta.html.career.4.title: Motiva Services Oy
minusta.html.career.4.desc: Business manager at the commercial subsidiary of Motiva Oy, the Finnish state's affiliated sustainability body.
minusta.html.career.5.title: Findera Consulting
minusta.html.career.5.desc: I have helped a large number of Finnish companies into German-speaking markets in particular, and created over 100 business connections. Alongside that I have delivered more than 70 study and benchmarking trips.
minusta.html.stats.langs: working languages: Finnish, German and English
minusta.html.style.title: A human touch, a professional delivery.
minusta.html.style.1.title: Approachable
minusta.html.style.1.desc: I know how to meet people. Clients tell me I am approachable, easy to talk to and pleasant company for all participants.
minusta.html.style.2.title: Cultural understanding
minusta.html.style.2.desc: Years of German-Finnish cooperation have taught me how two working cultures are brought together. On trips I also act as interpreter — of the language and of the way things are done.
minusta.html.style.3.title: Effortless for the client
minusta.html.style.3.desc: I handle the whole so that participants can focus on what matters: schedules, logistics and finding the right people are my responsibility.
minusta.html.cta.title3: Shall we talk about what you are aiming for?
minusta.html.about.p0a: I am Martin Brandt, the founder of FinDera Consulting. FinDera grew out of hands-on work with sustainable solutions, sustainable development and international connections. My operations naturally build upon the powerful drive of both my home countries, Germany and Finland, to lead the way in energy and circular economy solutions.
minusta.html.about.p0b: My background spans several kinds of stakeholder. I have worked on sustainability from a number of different vantage points over my career, which gives an unusually complete picture of what the different players need and what actually works in practice.
minusta.html.about.p4: This background is what FinDera is built on. I find the right players and choose the sites that genuinely benefit you. I open doors, confirm the meetings and shape the encounters so that they produce learning and collaboration.
minusta.html.alt.martin: Martin Brandt on a site visit at the Johan Cruijff ArenA in Amsterdam.
minusta.html.about.p5: At the core of my work is the ability to combine international research, an understanding of sustainability themes, the right contacts and practical delivery. Depending on the need, I support clients from scans and opening contacts to meetings, expert study trips and working on the lessons learned.

tietosuoja.html.meta.title: Privacy Policy — FinDera Consulting
tietosuoja.html.meta.desc: How FinDera Consulting processes personal data from the contact form: what data, for what purpose, how long it is kept and your rights.
tietosuoja.html.ph.title: Privacy Policy
tietosuoja.html.ph.lead: This policy explains what personal data FinDera Consulting processes, for what purpose, and what rights you have.
tietosuoja.html.ts.1.title: 1. Data Controller
tietosuoja.html.ts.1.body2:
Contact for data protection matters:
Martin Brandt
Email: martin.brandt@findera.fi
Phone: +358 50 336 3233
tietosuoja.html.ts.2.title: 2. What Data We Process
tietosuoja.html.ts.2.body: We process the information submitted through our contact form. Name and email address are required. Organisation name and phone number are optional and do not need to be provided. The form also lets you select which service your enquiry relates to and include a free-text message.
tietosuoja.html.ts.3.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
tietosuoja.html.ts.3.body1: We use this information solely to respond to your enquiry — for example, to provide a quote, information about a project, or answer any other question you raise.
tietosuoja.html.ts.3.body2: The legal basis for this processing is legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) of the General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR): we have a legitimate need to process your contact details in order to respond to the enquiry you have submitted. Processing is limited to this purpose.
tietosuoja.html.ts.4.title: 4. How Long We Keep Your Data
tietosuoja.html.ts.4.body: We retain your data for up to 24 months from your last contact with us, after which it is deleted unless there is another basis for retaining it (for example, an ongoing client relationship or a legal obligation, such as accounting requirements in case of invoicing).
tietosuoja.html.ts.5.title: 5. Do We Share Your Data With Third Parties
tietosuoja.html.ts.5.body1: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing or other purposes.
tietosuoja.html.ts.5.body2: We use Netlify (Netlify, Inc., United States) to technically operate our contact form; Netlify acts as our data processor. This means data submitted through the form passes through Netlify's infrastructure, which may involve transferring data outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers rely on safeguards recognised by the European Commission (such as Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, where the provider is certified under it). We also use Cloudflare Web Analytics (Cloudflare, Inc., United States) and Google Analytics (Google LLC, United States) for visitor statistics; see section 6 for details. We do not use any other third-party services to process your data.
tietosuoja.html.ts.6.title: 6. Cookies and visitor statistics
tietosuoja.html.ts.6.body: Our website does not set cookies without your permission. To measure visitor numbers we use Cloudflare Web Analytics, which sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser; the service does not identify individual visitors or track them across websites. The data collected is statistical: the page opened, the referring site, country, browser and device type. We also use Google Analytics, which sets a cookie on your device — that's why we ask for permission via the banner shown at the bottom of the page on your first visit, and it does not start until you press “Accept”. If you press “Decline” or close the banner, Google Analytics installs nothing on your device. Your choice is remembered in your browser's local storage, so the banner doesn't need to appear again on every visit; you can change your choice at any time by clearing it. The legal basis for Cloudflare's measurement is legitimate interest (EU General Data Protection Regulation, Article 6(1)(f)); the legal basis for Google Analytics is your consent. The LinkedIn link on our site is a standard hyperlink and does not set any cookies unless you click it and are taken to LinkedIn.
tietosuoja.html.ts.7.title: 7. Your Rights
tietosuoja.html.ts.7.li1: request access to your personal data
tietosuoja.html.ts.7.li4: object to processing or request that it be restricted
tietosuoja.html.ts.7.body1: You can exercise these rights by emailing martin.brandt@findera.fi. We will respond to your request within a reasonable time.
tietosuoja.html.ts.7.body2: If you believe your data has been processed unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Finnish Data Protection Ombudsman (tietosuoja.fi).
tietosuoja.html.ts.8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
tietosuoja.html.ts.8.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the latest update is shown at the top of this page.
